items.title: v1.6.6 发布：狂野派主题 · 公告离线兜底
items.body: 新主题「狂野派」四态循环上线；公告走同源接口国内秒开；测试版更新判定修复；断开连接即时省 token。
items.bodyEn: New Brutal theme in the four-state cycle; announcements now load via a same-origin API; prerelease update detection fixed; streams abort instantly on disconnect.

items.title: 新主题「狂野派」上线（Neo-Brutalism）
items.body: 奶油纸底 + 硬黑描边 + 零模糊硬投影；右上角调色板或菜单切换，四态循环。顺带修复首屏主题闪烁与手机地址栏跟色。
items.bodyEn: Cream paper, hard black outlines, zero-blur hard shadows — cycle it from the palette icon or the menu. Also fixes first-paint theme flash and mobile address-bar tint.

items.title: 讯飞 Loomy 免费池：8 个模型，短信直登
items.body: 免费额度区块原生收录，手机验证码直登换 14 天会话，无需装客户端；高峰期偏慢属正常。
items.titleEn: iFlytek Loomy free pool: 8 models via SMS login
items.bodyEn: Built into the free-tier section — phone SMS code signs a 14-day session, no client needed. Slower at peak hours.

items.title: 调度变更：到期包优先烧 + 双窗健康度
items.body: 资产包严格按到期压榨；订阅账号任一窗口见底即交接；429 冷却上限 24 小时。
items.bodyEn: Asset packs burn soonest-expiring first; subscription accounts hand over when either window bottoms out; 429 cooldown capped at 24h.

items.title: Antigravity 按家族隔离配额
items.body: Gemini 与 Claude/GPT 配额独立核算、独立选号；风控账号标红并附验证链接。
items.bodyEn: Gemini vs Claude/GPT quotas tracked and selected independently; risk-flagged accounts go red with a verify link.

items.title: 代理变更：不可直连渠道默认严格模式
items.body: 代理失败立即报错接力，不再回退直连死等（曾实测 788 秒）。
items.titleEn: Proxy change: direct-connect channels default to strict
items.bodyEn: Proxy failures now error immediately and relay instead of hanging on blocked direct connections (788s seen).

items.title: MiniMax Code Free 回归
items.body: 免登录网关线回归，订阅线支持每日自动签到。
items.bodyEn: The no-auth gateway lane is back; subscription lines gain daily auto check-in.

items.title: 组合 router 策略
items.body: 决策模型分析 prompt 动态挑最擅长的成员回答，失败 8 秒内退回原顺序。
items.bodyEn: A decision model picks the best-suited member per prompt; failures fall back within 8s.

items.title: Gemini 4 Argon 与 GPT-6.1 Sol 收录
items.body: Gemini 4 Argon 三线接入（1M 上下文）；Codex 新增 GPT-6.1 Sol（Responses Lite 协议）。
items.bodyEn: Gemini 4 Argon across three lanes (1M context); Codex adds GPT-6.1 Sol over Responses Lite.
